subject: Phased capacity commitment trajectory & amendment request — Viridian
messages:
From: Janelle Morris <janelle@viridian.ai>

Cc: Procurement <procurement@viridian.ai>
Date: 2026-07-12T13:10:00-04:00
Subject: Initial ask — phased GPU/TPM prepay for 2026–2028

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the throughput and the KV cache behavior on short-context workloads. We're ready to move from evaluation to a committed Dedicated play, but we need a multi-year prepay structure that matches our product rollout.

High-level asks:
- 3-year term (2026-07 to 2029-06) with phased capacity: start smaller in H2 2026 and ramp across quarters to steady-state in 2027.
- Prefer annual prepay invoicing, but open to hybrid annual + quarterly true-ups.
- Looking for clarity on term discounts, options for GPU vs TPM (token) sizing, and how unused commit is handled on a phased ramp.

Attached is a rough commit sheet with our proposed quarterly trajectory and an example SOW amendment request. Can you confirm what discount bands you would apply at 12, 24, and 36 month commitments, and whether there is a standard clause to move unused committed capacity between years?

Thanks,

Janelle Morris
VP of Product
Viridian AI

Attachment: Viridian_Initial_Commit_Sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Janelle Morris <janelle@viridian.ai>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, connor.obrien@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-12T15:22:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — phased GPU/TPM prepay for 2026–2028

Hi Janelle — great to hear and thanks for the clear sheet.

Quick answers up front, then a couple of clarifying Qs:
- Discount tiers we typically offer (guideline): 12-month prepay -> 8% v. list, 24-month -> 14%, 36-month -> 20%. Those are negotiable depending on burn profile and guaranteed minimums.
- We support commit transfer windows: for phased ramps we allow inter-year transfer up to 15% of the committed annual GPU-hours (subject to price band alignment), and we can include limited rollover credits for under-burn in year 1 if year‑2 prepay is signed before year 1 invoice is due.
- Pricing can be specified either as GPUs/month or TPM (tokens per month) with a hybrid monitoring clause so you only pay for the larger of committed GPU throughput or token-based consumption for billing clarity.

Clarifying Qs:
1) Do you want invoice timing on Jan 1 / Jul 1 or aligned to the start of each year relative to a DocuSign SOW signature?
2) How aggressive is the H2 2026 ramp? Your sheet shows 10% of target by Sep 2026 — would you prefer a quarterly ramp (Q3 2026 -> Q2 2027) or monthly increments?

I copied Lauren and Connor — they can propose a concrete amendment that maps the trajectory to billing/credit events. I’ve also attached a sample SOW amendment template that mirrors our standard phased-commit language.

Next step: if you can confirm invoice cadence and preferred ramp granularity today, we'll produce a 2nd-pass SOW with explicit pricing.

Regards,

Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Attachment: SOW_Viridian_Amendment_v2.pdf (PDF, redlines included)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-12T16:05:00-04:00
Subject: Internal: proposed concessions for VIR-4521

Rishi / Connor — quick internal note before we send final language to Viridian.

Proposal (leaning conservative given cluster availability):
- Offer: 24-month commitment as primary commercial path. If customer signs 36 months we can push to 18–20% discount. For 24 months target: 14% off list with a 6-month phased ramp allowance (no penalties if they reach committed steady-state by month 6).
- Year 1 ramp protection: allow rollover credits up to 10% of annual commit if they sign year 2 prepay within 45 days of year 1 invoice.
- Billing cadence: annual prepay for year 1 at signature + option to invoice year 2 at signature with deferred payment dates (we can keep taxes/invoicing aligned to customer's fiscal calendar).
- TPU/TPM hybrid clause: we price on GPU-equivalent units but include a token floor so high token bursts do not drive surprise overages; additive burst buffer billed at usage.

Operational note: include an explicit fallback model variant clause — if a requested specialized kernel is unavailable in a region we automatically route to compatible variant with standard throughput SLAs, and Redwood covers routing overhead for the first 30 days. That helps procurement sign-offs.

I think this gets us within range without exposing too much downside. Once Rishi has customer acceptance on cadence/ramp granularity we should generate an SOW w/ exact quarterly targets.

-Lauren
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Janelle Morris <janelle@viridian.ai>

Subject: Re: Initial ask — phased GPU/TPM prepay for 2026–2028

Thanks Rishi and Lauren — that all sounds reasonable and clear. A couple of small asks from procurement before we push to legal:

1) Slower ramp: we prefer a quarterly ramp rather than the 6-month milestone — specifically: 15% of steady-state in Q3 2026, 35% in Q4 2026, 65% by Q2 2027, 100% by Q4 2027. This smooths cashflow for us.
2) Rollover clarity: we want the rollover credit to explicitly be transferrable within the Viridian account across projects (not restricted to a single product line).
3) DocuSign: please send the amended SOW with the agreed 24-month commercial and the 14% discount; procurement will countersign once legal checks the transfer language.

If you can send the SOW via DocuSign today we can aim to have finance sign-off by Friday.

Best,

Janelle
VP of Product
Viridian AI

Janelle — thanks, understood and we can do that. Summary of agreed points below for signature:

- Commercial: 24-month prepay (VIR-4521) with a 14% discount off published list.
- Ramp cadence: quarterly trajectory (15% Q3 2026, 35% Q4 2026, 65% Q2 2027, 100% by Q4 2027). Will be included as Exhibit A (quarterly commit schedule).
- Rollover credits: up to 10% of annual committed GPU-hours allowed to rollover; rollover credits are transferable across Viridian projects under the same account and will be explicitly named in the SOW amendment.
- Billing: annual prepay; we will invoice Year 1 on signature and offer the option to invoice Year 2 at signature if Viridian prefers to prepay both years.
- Operational fallbacks: include variant routing and 30-day routing-cost protection language.

I’ve prepared an amended SOW and created a DocuSign envelope — link below. Please route to procurement/legal and we’ll standby for countersign.
